name: Frankfurt Airport

hours.v: flight operating hours 05:00 to 23:00 local time
hours.quote: The flight operating hours at Frankfurt Airport run from 5:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. local time.

curfew.v: night flight ban from 23:00 to 05:00; only safety-related diversions, disaster relief and medical aid flights may land; from 22:00 to 23:00 and 05:00 to 06:00 at most 133 movements per night (annual average)
curfew.quote: Between 11:00 p.m. and 5:00 a.m. CEST, there is a ban on night flights.

noise.v: aircraft without a noise-reduced ICAO noise class may fly only Monday to Friday 08:00 to 20:00, not at weekends
noise.quote: only permitted to fly from Monday to Friday between 8:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. CEST

slots.v: Level 3 coordinated airport; general aviation flights need a slot from the German airport coordinator (Fluko)
slots.quote: Coordination of General Aviation flights is required at the following Level 3 airports:
